based_on.owning_preimage_confirmation: CI owner confirmed the current e84 owning source still uses this exact test script; LF fixture and effective argv fixes are retained. This candidate is a three-path delta, not a claim the entire e84 tree was reverified.

problem.conclusion: Original successful targets were outside the failed-target-only collector. The original seven-ledger exit conditions require exact case bodies and attempt context, which target-level green or a cached summary cannot replace.
problem.b22_single_artifact_member_inference: The Windows shard3 upload reported one file, while the wrapper writes a compact execution log and invokes the collector only for failures. Interpreting that single uploaded file as the compact log is a source-plus-count inference; its ZIP member was not independently read in this audit.

changes.existing_upload_contract: The existing workflow already uploads CODEX_BAZEL_EXECUTION_LOG_COMPACT_DIR after success or failure. The added selected-target-test-logs directory lives inside that existing upload root.
changes.trigger: The existing --print-failed-test-logs option continues its failure-tail behavior. If the existing compact-log directory is configured and the original command is test, it additionally plans selected-target evidence after the original command completes, including an overall success.
changes.selection: Only exact allowlisted target summary lines from the completed invocation's owned console temp file are considered. PASSED and FLAKY select existing logs. SKIPPED, NOT_REPORTED, FAILED, TIMEOUT, NO STATUS, and conflicting summaries do not select successful-scope logs. The unchanged failed collector remains responsible for its original FAIL:/Testing failure targets.
changes.statuses: Each allowlisted target records all matching summary lines, a status, and the presence/absence/unknown state of the cached marker. Conflicting status/cache reports are explicitly AMBIGUOUS and incomplete, with no directory traversal.
changes.filters: NUL-separated existing wrapper arguments are handed to the collector in a temporary file with the existing Windows MSYS conversion guard. Only named config/filter/cache/timeout/retry/shard options are retained in metadata. This records wrapper-requested flags, not expanded Bazel RC options or a per-case selection proof.
changes.archive_scope: New schema bazel_selected_target_logs_v1 in selected-target-test-logs/invocation-*/manifest.json. Legacy failed-test-logs schema, filename semantics and normal CLI remain intact.
changes.source: Existing git commit/tree/tracked-worktree-dirty source checks run at collection time. The manifest explicitly does not claim test-start source identity or an independently established per-file invocation binding.
changes.unavailable: Missing local records, changing files, linked escapes, copy/source errors or ambiguous summaries make complete_for_selected_targets false and produce an explicit warning. The original Bazel exit code remains the result.
changes.no_remote_materialization: No download flag, cache policy, remote access, rerun or rebuild is added. Missing remote-success logs remain missing evidence; old local files are not silently promoted to a fresh execution.
changes.limits: complete_for_selected_targets only describes copying the selected existing records; complete_case_inventory is explicitly false. A cached marker is not a new platform execution. Its absence does not prove independent execution. NOT_REPORTED is not equivalent to filtered or skipped.
changes.file_preservation: The same safe copier preserves existing test.log, test.xml and test_attempts *.log/*.xml, with no truncation; per-file byte count, SHA256, local mtime and relative path are retained. test.outputs/runfiles are excluded.

original_regression_gate.existing_scope: CI owner reports the existing complete scope was 54 tests on the previous exact source. This candidate adds three definitions; the next sole-lane run must report its actual roster/count rather than borrowing 54 or assuming 57 passed.
necessary_original_controls: Original >1 MiB multi-shard / attempt binary-safe copying and hashes.
Existing real root link acceptance with path traversal / nested external link refusal.
Original output-creation failure keeps Bazel exit 37 and diagnostic tail.
Original successful unselected target does not invoke bazel info or create a failed archive.
Windows native argument transport, 900-target pattern file, effective expanded argv, CRLF query roster, and the owning LF fixture correction.

new_controls.purpose: Real temporary testlogs with >1 MiB binary content, shards, failed attempt log/XML, successful uncached/cached/flaky summaries, skipped/unreported stale logs and unrelated outputs. Assert exact copied payload set, file hashes/mtime, source identity, scope, cache markers and original argv/filter/retry/timeout preservation.
Missing successful local logs remain explicitly incomplete on both original Bazel status 0 and 37. The original failed target archive/tail remains available for status 37.
Conflicting PASSED/SKIPPED reports cannot promote an existing stale target log into evidence; ambiguity remains incomplete while original Bazel success remains 0.

actual_next_ci_acceptance: Apply only after all three current preimages are verified by the sole CI mutator; do not overwrite a newer owning test script.
Retain the same original workflow commands and their target/cache/retry/skip/time budgets.
Verify uploaded new-schema manifests, source commit/tree and track dirty state against the actual next source/merge checkout.
Use exact test.log/XML case and attempt bodies where present; retain cached/retried/filtered distinctions.
If remote-success logs are absent or local records lack an independently established invocation binding, keep the affected exact-case/platform gate open.
